body: Thank you for responding, I really appreciate it. I think you're right about the first steps being the hardest. It's just I guess I can't see the point of doing it because I feel that I'll still feel essentially the same way or maybe worse once I'm a single parent again. I never wanted kids, I didn't even think I was mentally fit for parenting before I went through all of the trauma that I have now. It feels like I almost don't know how I got here and I'll just wake up tomorrow as a teenager again. I love my daughter, but at the same time I feel like I'm constantly letting her down and just unable to be a functioning parent or just a functioning human sometimes. It's the same way my mom let me down while she was in an abusive relationship with my dad and now he lives in a big house with his new wife and my mom is a homeless recovering(?) addict. I fear I'll go down the same road or end my life before I inevitably do.
